name: dogfood-desktop-probe-app

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/desktop && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
